guitar.notes: McTell was renowned for his 12-string ragtime/blues guitar style; no single documented model survives as iconic.

tone.summary: A classic blues setup using a low-gain preamp (Blues OD) into a vintage British amp model (UK 45), paired with a small cab and subtle room ambience to capture the rootsy, dry slide feel.
